data: Microsoft reported revenue of $211.9 billion for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2023, up 7% from $198.3 billion in fiscal 2022 (an increase of about $13.6 billion, or roughly 6.9%). Net income for fiscal 2023 was $72.4 billion, which was down about 1% from $72.7 billion in fiscal 2022. The slower net income performance reflected, among other things, a charge of about $1.2 billion in the second quarter of fiscal 2023 tied to severance, hardware impairments and lease consolidation costs, and the figures are drawn from my recollection of Microsoft's annual report rather than a live lookup of the filing.
